question: What proportion of recitation should the wise practitioner devote to brahma and limb mantras?
premises: The wise one should perform brahma and limb recitation.
inference: Here the wise one should perform brahma and limb recitation as a tenth part of the root recitation.
plain_english: Here the wise one should perform the recitation of the brahma and limb mantras as a tenth part of the root recitation.
